from pathlib import Path
import collections
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u018/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # Full, single-color lines divide the grid into repeated panels.
    rowcuts = [-1] + rows + [h]
    colcuts = [-1] + cols + [w]
    rowspans = [(rowcuts[i] + 1, rowcuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(rowcuts)-1) if rowcuts[i+1] > rowcuts[i]+1]
    colspans = [(colcuts[i] + 1, colcuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(colcuts)-1) if colcuts[i+1] > colcuts[i]+1]
    counts = {}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if r not in rows and c not in cols:
                v = grid[r][c]
                counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    panels = []
    for r0, r1 in rowspans:
        for c0, c1 in colspans:
            score = sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            panels.append((score, r0, r1, c0, c1))
    _, sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1 = max(panels)
    source = [row[sc0:sc1] for row in grid[sr0:sr1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1 in rowspans:
        for c0, c1 in colspans:
            if (r0, r1, c0, c1) == (sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1):
                continue
            if r1-r0 == len(source) and c1-c0 == len(source[0]):
                for dr in range(len(source)):
                    out[r0+dr][c0:c1] = source[dr][:]
    return out
'''
p=program_dir/'task-00cbe9fd.py'
p.write_text(code)
